item.title: Bukidnon State University graduate is lone 2025 bar topnotcher from Mindanao schools
item.description: Bukidnon State University College of Law Batch 2025 graduate Gerilin Ano-os Gascon posted an 89.79% rating, ranking 14th nationwide. Gascon, who is also a certified public accountant, is among the 5,594 examinees who passed the 2025 Bar Examinations out of 11,424 who completed the three-day tests, according to figures issued by the high court. Photo courtesy of the Bukidnon State University (BSU) Information Unit.

item.title: RIVERMAN’S VISTA: The bar results and their significance to Mindanao
item.description: (MindaNews / 08 January) — When the Supreme Court released the 2025 Bar Examination results yesterday, revealing that 5,594 out of 11,425 examinees had passed, the headlines naturally focused on the improved 48.98% passing rate. item.title: No usable toilets for families displaced by Manay quake
item.description: MANAY, Davao Oriental (MindaNews / 9 January) – Toilets at the Bayanihan Village here have been used beyond capacity, affecting 50 families who were housed in modular shelter units after the doublet earthquake that struck in October last year.
